title: Search Committee
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office conducts a search for a new manager, with various characters expressing their ambitions, opinions, and suspicions. The episode features interviews, humorous interactions, and debates about leadership, culminating in ongoing discussions about who will be chosen as the new manager.

main_threads.thread: The search for a new manager at Dunder-Mifflin
